findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tblock_panel_open, tblock_command, tblock_game_state, tblock_plan_roll, tblock_plan_task · Private data: tblock_plan_birth, tblock_plan_swap, tblock_panel_open, tblock_command, tblock_game_state, tblock_plan_roll, tblock_plan_task, tblock_missions · Public sink: tblock_creator_minimum, tblock_panel_open, tblock_command, tblock_plan_settle, tblock_plan_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tblock_panel_open, tblock_command, tblock_game_state, tblock_plan_roll, tblock_plan_task · Private data: tblock_plan_birth, tblock_plan_swap, tblock_panel_open, tblock_command, tblock_game_state, tblock_plan_roll, tblock_plan_task, tblock_missions · Public sink: tblock_creator_minimum, tblock_panel_open, tblock_command, tblock_plan_settle, tblock_plan_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
